metadata.source: FantasyCalc dynasty SF values (revealed preference; ~1M+ real trades)
metadata.valueModel: players & drafted picks = current FC value; undrafted picks = FC Mid-tier pseudo-player; FAAB = $
metadata.note: FantasyCalc has no historical series; at-trade ("then") values use current FC value for every asset. Winners/margins recomputed on current FC values. FC scale is uncapped (~10k top); no 9999 cap applied.
